name: shin-neko ~Saikai Shita Imouto to no Arata na Kankei~
original_name: shin-neko ～再会した妹との新たな関係～
source:
The parents passed away while he was still young.
But he had a little sister he held very close.
Sadly to say, it would not remain that way. 

And then the time came for them to separate.
The brother lamented not being able to protect his sister as he'd resolved to.
Their final promise and farewell.
"When we become adults, if anything bad happens you can count on your brother! I'll help you no matter what!"
"Alright, promise..."

After 10 years, the brother sinks into thought, wondering how she's doing.

On the way home, he turns a corner and comes across that girl.
Astonished, she looks at the boy, who doesn't quite know how to react.
"Onii-chan...?"

The boy takes his sister back home for the time being, as the rain has began pouring.
Did he worry about her all the time? Was he fine with being apart?
Hearing all of his little sister's worries, he resolves once again to protect her.
And so they step forward. To make memories together, making up for every minute they were apart.

[Translated from the [url=http://milimili.amusecraft.com/shinneko/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
父母在他年幼时便已离世。
但他还有一名珍爱的妹妹。
遗憾的是，这样的日子并没有一直持续下去。

终于，兄妹不得不分离。
哥哥曾下定决心要保护妹妹，却因未能做到而悲伤。
临别前，两人许下最后的约定。
“等我们长大了，要是遇上什么不好的事，就来找哥哥！不管怎样，我都会帮你的！”
“嗯，约好了……”

十年后，哥哥陷入沉思，惦记着妹妹如今过得如何。

回家的路上，他转过街角，遇见了那个女孩。
女孩惊讶地望着他，而他一时不知该如何回应。
“哥哥……？”

大雨倾盆而下，他先把妹妹带回了家。
哥哥是不是一直在担心她？分开这么久，哥哥过得好吗？
听着妹妹满心的不安，他再次下定决心，一定要保护她。
于是，两人一同向前，为分开的每一分每一秒，补上新的共同回忆。

[译自[url=http://milimili.amusecraft.com/shinneko/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
